=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: agents.md
  Location: lines 828-839 (the paragraph split by the new title rules insertion)
  Issue: The original sentence "...which archives the previous stage session unless it is waiting on the user; a finished stage session is not woken to continue, because the gap between check-ins outlives the prompt cache..." is now split by a 9-line title-rules paragraph. The semicolon was converted to a period, and the "A finished stage session is not woken to continue" fragment now reads as the start of a new sentence after the inserted paragraph, losing the original "a finished stage session is not woken to continue" as a continuation of "unless it is waiting on the user;". The intended relationship (a finished session is not woken up in order to continue) is no longer obvious at first read.
  Suggested minimal fix: Move the new title-rules paragraph to a separate location (e.g., directly after the "Names say where the project is" line as a sub-block, or its own subsection), or rejoin the trailing fragment to the prior sentence: replace "unless it is waiting on the user." with "unless it is waiting on the user; a finished stage session is not woken to continue, because the gap between check-ins outlives the prompt cache and a wake would re-send the whole history at full price." then start the title rules as a new paragraph.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
